name: Payment Instrument 28 Choice
definition: Choice between types of payment instrument, that is, cheque, credit transfer or investment account.

CreditTransferDetails.name: Credit Transfer Details
CreditTransferDetails.definition: Payment instrument between a debtor and a creditor, which flows through one or more financial institutions or systems.

ChequeDetails.name: Cheque Details
ChequeDetails.definition: Written order on which instructions are given to an account holder (a financial institution) to pay a stated sum to a named recipient (the payee).

BankersDraftDetails.name: Bankers Draft Details
BankersDraftDetails.definition: Cheque drawn by a bank on itself or its agent. A person who owes money to another buys the draft from a bank for cash and hands it to the creditor.

CashAccountDetails.name: Cash Account Details
CashAccountDetails.definition: Part of the investment account to or from which cash entries are made.

BlockChainCashWallet.name: Block Chain Cash Wallet
BlockChainCashWallet.definition: Block Chain Wallet where digital currencies are maintained. This is the equivalent of cash account for digital currencies.
